freshness.unread.missing.text: A comment of the user's on this card can't be found, on the card or in its archive: ask the user what it said if you need it.
freshness.unread.missing.note: HI-2854: a refused submit's line for a comment of the user's it hasn't seen that is neither on the card nor in its archive (HI-2641), which can't be given (not expected: every such comment is on one or the other); it counts as received, so the refusal doesn't repeat for ever.
